name: EdwardTang/Intro_to_Self-Driving_Cars_Final
description: This is the final project of Coursera course Introduction to Self-Driving Cars. In this project, I wrote and implemented a controller for the CARLA simulator. The goal is to control the vehicle to follow a race track by navigating through preset waypoints. The vehicle needs to reach these waypoints at certain desired speeds, so both longitudinal and lateral control will be required.

name: scs805/shape-census
description: Shape Census is a Python tool for analyzing grids of binary data to identify and count connected shapes formed by adjacent '1's. Ideal for data analysts and puzzle enthusiasts interested in uncovering hidden patterns in binary grids.
